summary: TipKit is a contextual-tip framework: tip content, display rules, a persistent datastore, inline and popover views, and test hooks. BifrOSt has a tip model (ui tip.rs and tips.rs: tips, rules, a datastore with display frequency, groups and inline views), but no shell tip content and no popover anchor modifier. It has the building blocks a popover tip would need (a transient popover placed next to an anchor, a per-app persistent defaults store, a headless test window), but none of them is tied to tips.

features.note: Popover placement is tested headless (a_popover_goes_below_its_anchor_when_there_is_room, a_popover_flips_to_the_opposite_edge_when_the_preferred_side_has_no_room, a_popover_on_the_right_edge_opens_to_the_left, a_popover_stays_on_screen), and tip content, display limits, required events, invalidation and one-tip-at-a-time presentation are tested headless in tip.rs. Gap: no anchor modifier on SDK views and no action callback reaches the app yet, so an app wires the popover to its anchor by hand; the on-screen check needs Midget. Built 2026-10-17: springboard/sdk/src/tips.rs re-exports the TipKit model, present_first (picks the first eligible tip and records the display) and tip_popover_frame (placement next to the anchor); tests tips::tests.

Gap: no control draws a tooltip on hover and menu items have no tooltips yet; the pointer wiring and the drawn tooltip need Midget. Built 2026-10-17: springboard/sdk/src/tooltips.rs re-exports the Tooltips timing state machine for apps; tests tooltips::tests. Drawing on hover is still missing. Built 2026-10-17: TooltipHost (hover over registered control rectangles) and draw (ToolTip material, text above the control or below when there is no room) in springboard/sdk/src/tooltips.rs; tests tooltips::tests. Hover is not delivered to apps by the shell yet, so the drawn tooltip waits for that wiring.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 14 tests. Wave 2 (tipkit, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The headless test window can drive any view, and Datastore has show_for_testing, hide_for_testing and reset_datastore (ui tips.rs).

gaps: No tip content ships with the shell; the Tip, Rule and Parameter model is in springboard/ui/src/tips.rs.
No anchor modifier that presents a tip popover from an SDK view; the popover exists only as a low-level helper.
Hover tooltips have a timing model and a host (sdk tooltips.rs), but no shell control or menu draws them yet.
